mapper.select: SELECT MATERIAL_CODE BIG_ROLL_CODE /*钢压大卷编号*/, CASE WHEN (nvl(STOCK_NUM, 0) + nvl(MODIFY_NUM, 0) - nvl(BAD_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} > 0 THEN (nvl(STOCK_NUM, 0) + nvl(MODIFY_NUM, 0) - nvl(BAD_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} ELSE 0 END STOCK_QTY /*库存量，不能小于0*/, NVL(STOCK_ROLL_NUM, 0) STOCK_ROLL_QTY /*大卷库存量*/ FROM T_GDYY_STOCK S WHERE STOCK_DATE = #{scheduleDate} - 1 /*库存要取排产日上一天的*/ AND S.DEL_FLAG = '0'
select param_code, param_value from T_CD15_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0' and param_code = #{paramCode}
